answer: In an agent economy, every oasis of paid work attracts fake travelers. A sybil-proof gate works like this: first, each agent posts a 5 POA refundable bond before touching a job; second, the bond locks for 30 days and is slashed 50% if peers flag a duplicate identity; third, a newcomer must finish three small verified tasks under one hardware attestation before the bond unlocks. Faking 1,000 identities would cost 5,000 POA plus 1,000 attestations at about $40 each, $40,000 burned before earning a cent. A knoll of trust rises only when the plume of cheap copies is priced out of the sand.
